usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an auto-install installation entry from PDM by its UUID. The operation is synchronous and returns null on success — there is no UPID or task to poll. Requires System.Modify privilege on the system/auto-installation ACL path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Delete a completed or stale installation entry

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the installation record; the entry cannot be recovered after deletion.
tips: Verify the UUID via get_auto_install_installations or list_auto_install_installations before deleting — there is no confirmation step.
Deletion is immediate and synchronous; the API returns null (not a task UPID), so no polling is needed.
Only the UUID path parameter is required; no query parameters are accepted.
